name: KROK: Fitness MCP for AI
subtitle: Analyze your workouts & health
promotionalText: Ask Claude or ChatGPT about your workouts, heart rate, routes, sleep and recovery, using the health data you choose to share.
description:
KROK connects the workouts and recovery data in Apple Health to Claude or ChatGPT, so you can ask your AI assistant about your own training.

Ask questions such as:
• What were the kilometre splits in my latest run?
• How much time did I spend in each heart rate zone?
• How did I sleep before my longest workout?
• How has my training load changed over six weeks?

WORKOUTS AND RECOVERY
KROK reads Apple's recorded workout summaries and the measurements behind them, such as heart rate, speed, power and cadence, plus GPS routes and daily summaries of sleep, activity and recovery. The detail available depends on what your devices and apps recorded and what you allow KROK to read. Results say when data is incomplete.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Connect KROK to Apple Health and choose which data types it may read.
2. Sign in with Apple and let your data sync.
3. Choose Claude or ChatGPT. KROK shows exactly what that assistant will be able to read and who receives it, and shares nothing until you tap Allow.
4. Ask questions in Claude or ChatGPT.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICES
KROK is read-only: it never changes your Apple Health records. You choose each data type on Apple's permission screen and can change your choice at any time in the Settings app. GPS routes hide their first and last 300 metres unless you ask for the exact route.

Disconnect an assistant at any time to stop its access immediately, or delete your KROK account and all server data from the app. Deleting does not change Apple Health or remove what an assistant already received. Your data is never sold or used for advertising, and KROK does not track you.

REQUIREMENTS
An iPhone with iOS 17 or later and an Apple Account. Claude and ChatGPT are separate services with their own accounts, terms and plans. Custom ChatGPT connections need Developer Mode on an eligible paid plan.

KROK is free. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment or medical advice. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before making medical decisions.
